purpose: Define each q-family model/backend provider as an explicit identity/binding separate from model identity, command identity and target resource.

topics.name: Model Backend Identity
topics.purpose: Define each q-family model/backend provider as an explicit identity/binding separate from model identity, command identity and target resource.

semantics.identity_rule: Each backend/provider has an explicit identity.
semantics.model_rule: Backend may expose one or more exact model identities/profiles.
semantics.capability_rule: Context length/modalities/tool support are explicit validated capabilities.
semantics.target_rule: Backend identity never determines q/qc target by implication.
semantics.authority_rule: Backend availability grants no operation/data authority.

invariants.rule: Command, Routine, Trigger, Schedule, Tool and model definitions remain separate from invocations, requests, executions and results; definitions never create effects merely by existing.
Automated work still resolves exact operation/target/context and must cross validation, authorization and dispatcher boundaries before any effect occurs.

hard_gates.condition: backend name used as q target
